documents.title: H.R. 4521, Ukraine Security Assistance Act, signed into law
documents.text: The President signed H.R. 4521, the Ukraine Security Assistance Act, into law on October 21. The Act appropriates funds over two fiscal years for air-defense interceptors, artillery ammunition and spare parts for vehicles in service. The Senate passed the bill 68-30. The House passed the bill 311-112. The Act contains no provision for the recovery of disbursed funds.

documents.title: President signs Ukraine aid bill into law
documents.lead: The President signed the Ukraine aid bill into law on Tuesday. The first shipments are not expected within three weeks: the Pentagon has not published a delivery schedule, and the last package took eleven weeks.

documents.title: Statement by the President on signing the Ukraine Security Assistance Act
documents.text: Today I signed the Ukraine Security Assistance Act. Deliveries will begin within weeks. This assistance covers most of the air-defense gap for the winter.

documents.title: Executive Order: Additional sanctions on three sectors
documents.text: By the authority vested in me, I hereby impose additional sanctions on three sectors: energy equipment, maritime insurance and dual-use electronics. The order takes effect on November 1.
